title: Indian Armed Forces and Defence Basics: Quiz

questions.question: Who is the Supreme Commander of the Indian Armed Forces?
questions.rationale: The Constitution vests supreme command in the President. The CDS has no operational command.

questions.question: The post of Chief of Defence Staff was formed on:
questions.rationale: Cabinet approval came on 24 December 2019 and the post was formed on 1 January 2020.

questions.question: The Army's Northern Command is headquartered at:
questions.rationale: Northern Command sits at Udhampur. Pune is Southern, Jaipur South Western and Lucknow Central.

questions.question: Which pair is correctly matched?
questions.rationale: Western is at Mumbai, Eastern at Visakhapatnam and Southern at Kochi.

questions.question: Which of these is a tri-service command?
questions.rationale: The Andaman and Nicobar Command (2001) and the Strategic Forces Command (2003) are joint commands.

questions.question: Which rank in the Navy is equivalent to Colonel in the Army?
questions.rationale: Colonel, Navy Captain and Group Captain are equivalent. Commodore corresponds to Brigadier.

questions.question: Which of the following is the five-star rank in the Air Force?
options: Marshal of the Indian Air Force
questions.rationale: Marshal of the Indian Air Force is five-star and ceremonial; Arjan Singh held it from 2002.

questions.question: Navy Day is celebrated on 4 December to remember:
options: The 1971 attack on Karachi, Operation Trident
questions.rationale: The date marks the 1971 naval missile attack on Karachi harbour.

questions.question: Operation Meghdoot (1984) was launched to:
questions.rationale: Meghdoot secured the Siachen heights. Goa was Operation Vijay (1961) and the Maldives was Operation Cactus (1988).

questions.question: Which statement about Operation Vijay is correct?
options: It was used in 1961 for Goa and in 1999 for Kargil
questions.rationale: The name was used twice: Goa, Daman and Diu in 1961, and Kargil in 1999.

questions.question: Which missile is NOT part of the original IGMDP?
questions.rationale: BrahMos is an India-Russia joint venture cruise missile. The five IGMDP missiles are Prithvi, Agni, Akash, Trishul and Nag.

questions.question: Nag is classified as a:
questions.rationale: Nag is the anti-tank guided missile of the IGMDP.

questions.question: Who led the Integrated Guided Missile Development Programme?
questions.rationale: Dr Kalam led the programme from the early 1980s.

questions.question: The Operation launched by India in May 2025 after the Pahalgam attack was named:
questions.rationale: Operation Sindoor (7-10 May 2025). Parakram was the 2001-02 mobilisation.

questions.question: The DRDO was formed in which year?
questions.rationale: DRDO was formed in 1958 and works under the Ministry of Defence.
